gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Lung Cheung Road adjacent to the southwest corner of Block 4 of Upper Wong Tai Sin Estate, running northerly for approximately 110 m, then north-easterly for approximately 255 m, terminating at the southeast corner of Block 15 of Upper Wong Tai Sin Estate. Shown coloured pink on drawing No. KH 1791/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 起點與龍翔道在上黃大仙邨第四座西南角之處會合，向北行約一百一十公尺，然後向東北行約二百五十五公尺，終點在上黃大仙邨第十五座東南角。（在KH1791/1號圖則上用粉紅色標明）

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Wong Tai Sin Road, running north-westerly for approximately 150 m and terminating at its junction with the loop road of Fung Mo Interchange. Shown coloured green on drawing No. KH 1791/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 起點與黃大仙道會合，向西北行約一百五十公尺，終點與鳳舞交匯處之迴旋路會合。（在KH1791/1號圖則上用綠色標明）
